أَنِيفٌ (assumed tropical:) A mountain which produces vegetation before other regions. (Ibn-'Abbád, K.) And أَرْضٌ أَنِيفَةٌ, (T, M,) or أَنِيفَةُ النَّبْتِ, (S, K,) (assumed tropical:) Land that produces its vegetation early: (T:) or that produces vegetation quickly: (Et-Táee, ISk, S, K:) or that produces vegetation; as also ↓ أُنُفٌ . (M.) ＝
-A2- Applied to iron, i. q. أَنِيثُ; i. e. Soft. (Aboo-Turáb, T, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
